calls.title: Usim + GrowthBook
calls.summary: Christian Liebenow (GrowthBook) and Muhammed Zaulifqar (fractional CPO at USIM) discussed USIM's need for feature flagging and experimentation to enable safe, phased rollouts of a major app redesign—avoiding risky all-at-once deployments—and eventually support A/B testing with minimal engineering involvement. Next steps: Christian will share a video of GrowthBook's GenAI visual editor and documentation on phased rollouts and the iOS SDK; Muhammed
